verdict.rationale: mParticle documents routing data to 'hundreds of vendors' through an integrations directory. A community user confirms forwarding to around 10 analytics providers. Per-destination filtering is shown through forwarding rules and consent filters, but per-destination mapping is only implied by a doc titled 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle'. missing for 10: documented per-destination field/event mapping, detailed per-destination filtering configuration beyond consent-based forwarding rules, an explicit destination catalog listing with per-integration docs.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: simplifies how you collect and connect your user data to hundreds of vendors without needing to manage multiple integrations
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory, and click the card for your audience partner of choice.
Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle
we can send data only to mParticle and then send it onwards to possibly 10 other analytics providers
